# Stigmergic_Neural_Plasticity

**Domain**: iNEST

## Definition
A neuromorphic adaptation rule where synaptic weights are modified based on environmental trace accumulation, mimicking insect colony behavior. Offers a biologically plausible learning mechanism for iNEST systems to handle multi-agent coordination without centralized control.
